content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Motion control and motor manufacturer for industrial equipment; it builds electromechanical products, not fabless audio and mixed-signal chips."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Diversified instruments and electromechanical devices maker serving industrial and defense customers; no semiconductor chip design business."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Specialty chemical ingredients maker for personal care and pharma; it makes chemicals, not electronic chips."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Construction products, HVAC and industrial components maker; sells building materials, not semiconductors or consumer electronics chips."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"IoT connectivity hardware and cloud software seller; it builds networking devices rather than designing chips for device makers."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Brand owner of automotive aftermarket replacement parts sold to retailers; different products, customers and channels."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Electronic components distributor buying from manufacturers; it resells parts rather than designing and selling its own chips."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Specialty chemicals and advanced materials maker for industrial manufacturers; no chip design or electronics business."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Digital custom prototype parts manufacturer; it machines and molds parts on order, not designing semiconductor products."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Medical device maker selling catheters and surgical products to hospitals; a different business entirely."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Industrial hardware, locks and metal castings manufacturer; makes mechanical products, not electronic chips."}]}
